title: Checking In at the Clinic
source: 原創基礎課程：小綠書 U07 情境功能改寫
summaryZh: 在看診前向診所櫃檯簡短說明症狀與開始時間；不確定的過敏資訊不猜測，交由醫療人員確認。

learning.objectiveZh: 在登記時說明症狀與開始時間，並對不確定的過敏資訊如實表示未知。

vocabulary.en: A change in the body that a person notices.
Pain or irritation in the throat.
Feeling that you may lose your balance.
A reaction to something that affects a person's body.

task.titleZh: 換個條件：說明咳嗽何時開始
task.setupZh: 你有咳嗽，今天早上開始；你不確定是否對藥物過敏。只說自己知道的事，並詢問能否稍後補充資料。不提供診斷或治療建議。

steps.promptZh: 說明咳嗽今天早上開始，並如實表示不確定藥物過敏資訊。
steps.frame: It started ___. I'm not sure about ___.
steps.sample: It started this morning. I'm not sure about medicine allergies.

steps.partner: That's okay. The nurse can ask you more.
steps.promptZh: 確認看診時能否再補充症狀和過敏資訊。
steps.frame: Can I tell the nurse more about ___?
steps.sample: Can I tell the nurse more about my symptoms?

success: 我有說明症狀與開始時間。
我對不知道的過敏資訊沒有猜測。
我有確認可由醫療人員繼續詢問。

spokenPractice.noteZh: 核心句已足夠完成登記；以下替代說法是選修，不構成醫療建議。

alternatives.natural: I've had a sore throat since yesterday.
alternatives.guidanceZh: 現在完成式可簡潔表達症狀從昨天持續到現在。

alternatives.natural: I'm not certain about any allergies.
alternatives.guidanceZh: not certain 和 not sure 意思相近；先聽懂即可。

alternatives.clear: May I tell the nurse more?
alternatives.natural: Could I give the nurse a little more information?
alternatives.guidanceZh: give someone more information 是補充資料的自然說法。

drill.setupZh: 把兩種症狀和不同開始時間分開說，避免讓櫃檯誤會。

turns.speaker: 診所櫃檯
turns.text: When did the cough and headache start?

turns.speaker: 你
turns.text: The cough started today. The headache started yesterday.

drill.successZh: 讓兩個症狀各自對應正確時間即可；不用推測原因。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hi. I'd like to check in for an appointment.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course. What symptoms are you having?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I have a sore throat, and I feel a little dizzy.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.zh: 這些症狀什麼時候開始的？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: My throat started hurting yesterday. I felt dizzy this morning.
sentences.zh: 我昨天開始喉嚨痛，今天早上開始頭暈。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Do you know if you have any allergies?
sentences.zh: 你知道自己有沒有過敏嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'm not sure. I haven't been tested for allergies.
sentences.zh: 我不確定。我沒有做過過敏檢測。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's okay. I'll note that the information is unknown for the nurse.
sentences.zh: 沒關係。我會註明這項資訊仍不確定，讓護士確認。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you. Could I give the nurse more information about my symptoms?
sentences.zh: 謝謝。我可以再向護士補充症狀資訊嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. The nurse will speak with you shortly.
sentences.zh: 可以。護士很快會和你談。

questions.q: What two symptoms does the patient mention?
questions.explanationZh: 病人說喉嚨痛，也覺得有點頭暈。

options: The sore throat yesterday and dizziness this morning
questions.explanationZh: 病人把喉嚨痛和頭暈的開始時間分別說明。

questions.q: Is the patient certain about allergies?
questions.explanationZh: 病人說不確定，櫃檯會註明並交由護士確認。
